# harness_platform_idp_integration (Resource)

Resource for an IDP integration, which imports entities from an external system or Harness.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Custom webhook integration. The webhook URL is in endpoints once created.
resource "harness_platform_idp_integration" "orders" {
  identifier  = "orders_webhook"
  name        = "Orders webhook"
  description = "Imports services pushed by the order system"
  type        = "Custom"
  tags        = ["team:idp", "webhook"]

  custom {
    mode         = "webhook"
    source_label = "orders"

    webhook_auth {
      auth_type   = "hmac_auth"
      hash_algo   = "hmac_sha256"
      auth_header = "X-Signature"
      secret_ref  = "account.orders_webhook_secret"
    }

    # Optional; the kind's default columns are used when omitted.
    layout {
      column {
        title = "Service"
        path  = ".spec.service"
      }
    }
  }

  kind {
    kind        = "custom"
    auto_import = true
    action      = "merge"

    # Sent with the create, so the first webhook already uses it. Omitted fields keep the defaults.
    mapping {
      ingestion {
        identifier = ".service.id"
        name       = ".service.name"
        properties = {
          team = ".service.team"
        }
      }
      # Merges payloads into entities that already exist. Required for kinds with action merge.
      correlation {
        source_path = "service.id"
        target_path = "metadata.identifier"
      }
    }
  }
}

# Harness CD integration, reading services from every scope of the account.
resource "harness_platform_idp_integration" "harness_cd" {
  identifier = "harness_cd"
  name       = "Harness CD"
  type       = "HarnessCD"

  scopes {
    all = true
  }

  kind {
    kind        = "service"
    auto_import = true
  }
}

# ServiceNow CMDB integration in an organization, synced every 12 hours.
resource "harness_platform_idp_integration" "servicenow" {
  identifier       = "servicenow_prod"
  name             = "ServiceNow prod"
  org_id           = "default"
  type             = "ServiceNow"
  update_frequency = "12h"

  connector {
    inline {
      credentials_ref = "account.servicenow"
    }
  }

  kind {
    kind             = "cmdb_ci_service"
    auto_import      = true
    replication_mode = "incremental"
    filter           = ".operational_status == \"1\""
    # ServiceNow kinds have no default entity kind or type, so set both. They can't change later.
    idp_kind = "component"
    idp_type = "service"

    mapping {
      display_name_field = "name"

      # Source fields are top-level fields of the kind's catalog stream.
      field_mapping {
        source_field = "owned_by"
        target_field = "spec.owner"
      }
      field_mapping {
        source_field = "environment"
        target_field = "metadata.environment"
      }
    }
  }
}

# Harness CI integration. Every kind needs a correlation, so each kind has a mapping.
resource "harness_platform_idp_integration" "harness_ci" {
  identifier = "harness_ci"
  name       = "Harness CI"
  type       = "HarnessCI"

  kind {
    kind = "pipeline"

    mapping {
      correlation {
        # A field of the emitted entity data, matched against existing entities.
        source_path = "metadata.integration_properties.HarnessCI.pipelineName"
        target_path = "metadata.name"
      }
    }
  }
}

# GitHub integration for one organization's repositories.
resource "harness_platform_idp_integration" "github" {
  identifier = "github"
  name       = "GitHub"
  type       = "GitHub"

  connector {
    inline {
      credentials_ref = "account.github"
    }
  }

  github {
    orgs = ["acme"]
  }

  kind {
    kind = "repo_details"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the integration, stored as sent.
- `kind` (Block List, Min: 1) A kind to sync. Import reads kinds sorted by name, so list them that way to import without a diff. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kind))
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `type` (String) Integration type, e.g. ServiceNow, GitHub, HarnessCD or Custom.

### Optional

- `bitbucket_cloud` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for BitbucketCloud integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--bitbucket_cloud))
- `catalog_info` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for CatalogInfo integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--catalog_info))
- `connector` (Block List, Max: 1) Connector the integration reads with. Required or not allowed depending on type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--connector))
- `custom` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for Custom integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom))
- `datadog` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for DataDog integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--datadog))
- `description` (String) Description of the resource.
- `dynatrace` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for DynaTrace integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--dynatrace))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration syncs.
- `gcp` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for GCP integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--gcp))
- `github` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for GitHub integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--github))
- `harness_cd` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for HarnessCD integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--harness_cd))
- `harness_code` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for HarnessCode integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--harness_code))
- `harness_k8s` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for HarnessK8s integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--harness_k8s))
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization.
- `pagerduty` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for PagerDuty integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--pagerduty))
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier of the project.
- `scopes` (Block List, Max: 1) Harness scopes a platform integration reads from. Set exactly one of all or selected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--scopes))
- `secondary_kinds` (Set of String) Secondary kinds to sync, for Airbyte types.
- `sonarqube` (Block List, Max: 1) Settings for SonarQube integrations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sonarqube))
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags to associate with the resource.
- `update_frequency` (String) How often an Airbyte integration syncs, e.g. 24h.

### Read-Only

- `connector_version` (String) Connector image tag recorded at create.
- `created` (Number) Creation time, in milliseconds since the epoch.
- `effective_kinds` (List of String) Kinds that sync, including secondary kinds.
- `endpoints` (List of Object) URLs that receive data, per kind. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `health` (String) Health of the integration.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mode_effective` (String) How the integration gets data: airbyte, platform, webhook or api.
- `revision` (Number) Revision, sent as If-Match on writes.
- `uid` (String) Internal key; new on every create.
- `updated` (Number) Last update time, in milliseconds since the epoch.

<a id="nestedblock--kind"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kind`

Required:

- `kind` (String) Kind name.

Optional:

- `action` (String) register, merge or merge_register; the type's default when omitted.
- `auto_import` (Boolean) Import new entities automatically.
- `filter` (String) JQ that returns true for records to keep.
- `idp_kind` (String) Airbyte types: entity kind, e.g. component; the type's default when omitted. Set at create only; required for kinds with no default, such as ServiceNow's.
- `idp_type` (String) Airbyte types: entity type, e.g. service; the type's default when omitted. Set at create only.
- `mapping` (Block List, Max: 1) The kind's mapping, sent with the create so the first sync uses it. Omitted fields keep the type's defaults. Without the block the mapping isn't managed; removing the block resets it to the type's default, except for Custom and HarnessCI kinds, which have none and keep theirs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kind--mapping))
- `replication_mode` (String) Airbyte types: full_refresh or incremental; the stream's default when omitted.

<a id="nestedblock--kind--mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kind.mapping`

Optional:

- `correlation` (Block List, Max: 1) Links records to existing entities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kind--mapping--correlation))

- `field_mapping` (Block List) Maps a source field to an entity field. Airbyte types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--kind--mapping--field_mapping))
- `idp_kind` (String) Entity kind, e.g. component.
- `idp_type` (String) Entity type, e.g. service.

- `payload_schema` (String) Custom types, custom kind: JSON Schema of the payload. Set at create only.
- `unique_identifier_field` (String) Source field that identifies an entity. Can't change on Airbyte types.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import an account level integration
terraform import harness_platform_idp_integration.example <integration_id>

# Import an org level integration
terraform import harness_platform_idp_integration.example <org_id>/<integration_id>

# Import a project level integration
terraform import harness_platform_idp_integration.example <org_id>/<project_id>/<integration_id>
```
